verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs list BYOC (bring-your-own-cloud) and single-tenant deployments, so the product can run in a customer's own cloud environment. That is a documented form of hosting the core product on your own infrastructure. The evidence is a single line, though: it doesn't say who operates a BYOC deployment, and nothing shows a downloadable or on-prem self-managed distribution. missing for 10: documented self-managed/on-prem installation, BYOC deployment and operations details, clarity on who operates BYOC instances, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
